semiconductor_relevance: High — Resonac International provides essential materials for both front-end and back-end semiconductor processes.
summary: Resonac International(Taiwan) Co., Ltd specializes in advanced materials critical for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include adhesives, epoxies, die attach compounds, underfill materials, and conductive and non-conductive materials, as well as molding, encapsulation, potting, and resin materials for packaging. They also produce package substrates, laminates, and film-based materials, supporting a wide range of semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Adhesives and epoxies for semiconductor applications
Die attach compounds and underfill materials

regional_presence.Taiwan: Resonac International operates in Taiwan, focusing on providing materials for the semiconductor industry.
